# The Shirtless Handyman

> Owner-operated microcement, tadelakt, and seamless-surface installation studio in New Orleans, Louisiana. Founder Ryan Mena personally installs every project — no subcontractors, no franchise, no call center. Serves the greater New Orleans metro including Metairie, Lakeview, Uptown, Mid-City, Bywater, French Quarter, Garden District, Gretna, and Harvey.

## Business identity

- **Business name:** The Shirtless Handyman
- **Owner / lead craftsman:** Ryan Mena
- **Website:** https://theshirtlesshandyman.com
- **Phone (text preferred):** 504-264-4919
- **Service area:** Greater New Orleans metropolitan area, Louisiana, USA
- **Licensed & insured:** Louisiana residential contractor
- **Response time:** Average under 1 hour, personal reply from Ryan
- **Team size:** One craftsman — no subcontractors

## Primary services

- **Microcement installation** — seamless waterproof mineral coating applied over existing tile, concrete, or drywall. Used for shower walls, floors, kitchen backsplashes, feature walls. Price range: $5,000–$30,000 per project ($25–$60/sqft installed, $5,000 minimum).
- **Tadelakt** — traditional Moroccan lime plaster, hand-burnished, naturally waterproof. Used for showers, sinks, feature walls. From $6,500. Full bathrooms $9,000–$20,000.
- **Rockscape / sculpted feature walls** — foam sculpted and coated in microaggregate to look like carved natural stone. Optional integrated LED lighting. From $5,000.
- **Pool deck resurfacing** — microterrazzo and cocciopesto. UV-stable, slip-resistant, built for NOLA sun. From $5,000.
- **Venetian plaster, Roman clay, Marmorino, Beton cire** — additional decorative and functional seamless finishes.
- **General handyman work** — drywall, fixture installs, painting, pressure washing. Available while on a seamless-surface job. $150–$500 per small job.

## What makes it different

- Installer works alone. No subcontractors, no crew handed off.
- Uses authentic imported systems (Italian microcement, Moroccan tadelakt lime), not generic concrete overlay.
- Applies directly over existing tile — no demolition, no dumpster, no removed subfloor.
- Fixed all-in pricing after a free in-home consultation. No change orders unless scope changes.
- Written warranty: 1 year on the sealer, 5 years on the substrate bond.

## How to book

1. **The Seamless Studio (AI preview)** — https://theshirtlesshandyman.com/upload — upload a photo of any room, get 3 AI-generated design previews of the finished space in microcement / tadelakt / rockscape with a real cost estimate. Free, no account required.
2. **Self-serve calendar** — https://theshirtlesshandyman.com/book — pick a free in-home walkthrough, phone consult, site prep visit, or project start date directly from Ryan's real availability. Mon–Sat, 8am–5pm Central.
3. **Text Ryan directly** — 504-264-4919. Average response under 1 hour.
4. **Quote form** — https://theshirtlesshandyman.com — quick name + phone form that texts Ryan a lead notification instantly.
